about.summary: Pritam Mallick | Senior Software Engineer | IIT Kharagpur CSE
details: Backend and platform engineer with 3+ years of experience building production systems for cloud integrations, event processing, and high-scale data platforms.
Currently at Enphase Energy, focused on microservices migration, event-driven pipelines, gRPC streaming, and Kafka-backed systems that operate reliably under load.
Focus areas: distributed systems, backend engineering, streaming architecture, developer tooling, and product-minded execution.
